evidence.quote:
requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: Mandating a signed manifest before deployment appeals to security and process integrity as the governing good.

evidence.quote: that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Justifying the gate by prior security failure appeals to conservation — preventing recurrence as the motive.
Restating the gate as a formal requirement performs the same security-as-governing-good move.
Extending the gate's scope to all deployment environments appeals to comprehensive security coverage.
Naming oneself as owner of the gate claims standing and accountability over the process.

mints.name: GateAsSecurityMandate
mints.title: a gate whose whole reason is preventing unsigned artifacts from reaching staging
mints.frame: Is the expression appealing to security and process integrity as the governing good that justifies a mandatory gate?
